Task: Silicon Surface Energy - Level 1
Description: Calculate the surface energy of Silicon in the given surface by removing periodic boundary conditions in the given direction and computing the energy difference per unit area between the bulk and surface configurations. Use the Stillinger–Weber (SW) potential and the following simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Return the surface energy in eV/Å² units.

numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)

Thought: Now I'll create the LAMMPS input script for surface energy calculation with non-periodic boundary in z direction [001].
Action: write_file
Action Input: {"path": "/results/claude_35/react/surface_energy/subtask_false/level_1/brief/silicon_surface_energy_1_trial_1/in.surface", "content": "# Surface Si energy calculation
units metal
atom_style full

boundary p p f

read_data Si.data

pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

replicate 5 5 5

minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}

variable natoms equal count(all)
variable surface_energy equal pe/v_natoms

# Get box dimensions
variable lx equal lx
variable ly equal ly

# Calculate surface area (2 surfaces created)
variable area equal v_lx*v_ly

# Calculate surface energy
variable surf_energy equal (v_surface_energy-v_bulk_e)*v_natoms/(2*v_area)

print "${surf_energy}" file surface_energy.txt"}
